post.description:
Cancels a upgrade desktop operation and reboots the source desktop in its source pool. Use this command after a upgrade desktop operation fails. Otherwise, the desktop will remain unavailable. This is an asynchronous command.

Supported Clouds: Azure

parameters.name: desktopId
parameters.description: <span style="font-family: Open Sans,sans-serif; font-size:13px">The desktopId

202.description: Request accepted. Returns a statusURL for polling, which is an instance of the GET /v1.0/operation/{operationId} command.

post.summary: Sets the retention period for a desktop on suspension.
post.description: <span style="font-family: Open Sans,sans-serif; font-size:13px">The desktop will be deleted once the retention period is complete. For already suspended desktops the start of retention period will begin from the API call time. For assigned desktops the retention period will start from the suspension time. Retention period should be a non-negative integer (like 0,1,2,3,.. ). This is a synchronised command.

parameters.name: desktopId
parameters.description: <span style="font-family: Open Sans,sans-serif; font-size:13px">The unique ID string for the desktop. This is obtained through the GET /v1.0/pools/{poolId}/desktops command and others.

parameters.name: vmRetentionPeriod
parameters.description: <span style="font-family: Open Sans,sans-serif; font-size:13px">Number of days (positive integer) after which the desktop is deleted. For “0” desktop will be retained for indefinite period.

200.description: Success. Returns updated desktop details.

post.summary: Upgrades a persistent desktop to the specified pool
post.description:
Upgrades a persistent desktop from its current pool to the destination pool. Ownership of the desktop is preserved and the owner will launch it from its new region/pool as usual from the client interface. This is an asynchronous command.

Supported Clouds: Azure

parameters.name: desktopId
parameters.description: <span style="font-family: Open Sans,sans-serif; font-size:13px">The desktopId to upgrade

parameters.name: upgradeDesktopRequest
parameters.description: <span style="font-family: Open Sans,sans-serif; font-size:13px">The targetPool along with domain join details(if you do not want retain the source name). If AAD only account just provide targetPool and retainName or computerName.

202.description: Request accepted. Returns a statusURL for polling, which is an instance of the GET /v1.0/operation/{operationId} command.
